transcript.text: Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. I can help with that. When a tumble dryer appears to be "not working," it is often due to simple settings or airflow issues rather than a major fault. The most common causes are a selected cool-air programme, a blocked lint filter tripping the safety cut-out, or a door not latched properly. Please ensure you have started a normal heat cycle and check that the door closes firmly with an audible click. Also, please remove and clean the fluff filter in the door opening to rule out any airflow blockage causing it to shut down.
The door doesn't click shut, it swings back slightly open. The plastic tongue on the door has snapped off, found the piece on the floor. No sound at all when I press start.

The broken plastic tongue explains why the dryer isn't starting, as the machine won't run if the door doesn't latch fully to engage the safety switch. Since this is a mechanical part failure rather than an electrical fault, we need to source the correct replacement handle or catch for your specific model. Could you please tell me the make and model number of your tumble dryer? This information is usually found on a sticker inside the door opening, but if the door won't open properly right now, that can wait until later.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
It's a Hotpoint. I don't know the model number offhand, but I can read it from inside the door recess if you need it. Do you want me to go and check?

[Heading: Likely cause: door handle]
Yes, please go ahead and check for the model number so we can identify the correct replacement part. The broken plastic tongue is most likely preventing the machine from starting because the safety switch isn't being engaged. Once you have that code, I can help you find the right handle or catch to fix it.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
ok, I'll go and look now. Is it the sticker inside the door recess you want me to read out?

[Heading: Likely cause: door handle]
Yes, please read out the details from the sticker inside the door recess. The broken plastic tongue is preventing the door from latching properly, which stops the safety switch from engaging and explains why there is no sound when you press start. Once I have that model number, I can help you find the correct replacement part to fix it. If you can't reach the label right now because of the door issue, don't worry about it for a moment.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
Yes, going to look now. Is it just the model number you need from the sticker, or the other codes too?

[Heading: Likely cause: door handle]
Just the model number from the sticker is all I need. The broken plastic tongue on your door is preventing the machine from starting because the safety switch isn't being engaged. Once you have that code, we can find the right replacement part to fix it. If the label is hard to reach with the door not closing properly, don't worry about it for a moment and let me know when you've had a chance to look.
